doc.brief: The QColorDialog class provides a dialog widget for specifying colors.

QColor currentColor() const.brief: This property holds the currently selected color in the dialog

QColor customColor(int index).brief: Returns the custom color at the given *index* as a [QColor](xref:qt:QColor) value.

QColor getColor(const QColor &initial, Q.brief: Pops up a modal color dialog with the given window *title* (or "Select Color" if none is specified), lets the user choose a color, and returns that color.

QColor selectedColor() const.brief: Returns the color that the user selected by clicking the **OK** or equivalent button.

QColor standardColor(int index).brief: Returns the standard color at the given *index* as a [QColor](xref:qt:QColor) value.

QColorDialog(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a color dialog with the given *parent*.

QColorDialog(const QColor &initial, QWid.brief: Constructs a color dialog with the given *parent* and specified *initial* color.

QColorDialog::ColorDialogOptions options.brief: This property holds the various options that affect the look and feel of the dialog

bool testOption(QColorDialog::ColorDialo.brief: Returns `true` if the given *option* is enabled; otherwise, returns false.

int customCount().brief: Returns the number of custom colors supported by [QColorDialog](xref:qt:QColorDialog).

void colorSelected(const QColor &color).brief: This signal is emitted just after the user has clicked **OK** to select a color to use.

void currentColorChanged(const QColor &c.brief: This signal is emitted whenever the current color changes in the dialog.

void open(QObject *receiver, const char.brief: Opens the dialog and connects its [colorSelected](xref:qt:QColorDialog)() signal to the slot specified by *receiver* and *member*.

void setCurrentColor(const QColor &color.brief: This property holds the currently selected color in the dialog

void setCustomColor(int index, QColor co.brief: Sets the custom color at *index* to the [QColor](xref:qt:QColor) *color* value.

void setOption(QColorDialog::ColorDialog.brief: Sets the given *option* to be enabled if *on* is true; otherwise, clears the given *option*.

void setOptions(QColorDialog::ColorDialo.brief: This property holds the various options that affect the look and feel of the dialog

void setStandardColor(int index, QColor.brief: Sets the standard color at *index* to the [QColor](xref:qt:QColor) *color* value.

currentColor.brief: The currently selected color in the dialog

options.brief: The various options that affect the look and feel of the dialog
